fix_round.trigger: independent review found 6 BLOCKING defects; all fixed with tests on the real paths

defects.was: practice_starts.wave_call put runtime/checkpoint/noise_seed/warm_history/accel_bounds/sim_s/deterministic into extras while accel_runner.wave passes them as explicit keywords plus **extras -> TypeError 'multiple values for keyword argument noise_seed'
defects.now: extras carry only practice+branch; the RECORDED snapshot sumo configuration travels inside extras['practice']['snapshot'] and accel_runner.wave_jobs (wave's job construction, extracted verbatim as the real path) passes each keyword EXACTLY ONCE sourced from the snapshot; a duplicate extras key is a hard TypeError again (EXPLICIT_JOB_KEYS guard). Test: test_wave_call_output_builds_real_accel_runner_wave_jobs calls the REAL wave job construction with wave_call output.

defects.was: v2v_live.safety required a same-world A result (v2v1_warm_u{u}_A_{seed}) for every episode; practice episodes run on snapshot worlds -> ValueError
defects.now: for each practice episode v2v_live.safety runs ONE matched A-policy reference episode from the SAME snapshot and CRN seed (frozen 'pa' slot ids, A's update-u checkpoint, no guide), dispatched as ONE batch wave charged 1200 sim-s to the arm's practice phase (v2v_train) and quoted (launch3_check phase_costs + prepare_intent's v2v_train allocation cover the registered upper bound practice_starts.reference quote = 2 arms x 24 updates x 6 x 1200 = 345600); the exact pairs feed composite_health.braking (collisions/teleports hard constraints + critical_total CI) and the paired hard-brake bootstrap via a new optional exact-pairs argument (default None = byte-identical legacy pairing); a missing matched reference fails closed. Hard safety applies to practice episodes as to all others; no check skipped or weakened.

defects.was: practice episodes ran as 1-job waves -> one failure tripped run_train_jobs' >20% escalation before any replacement
defects.now: all practice episodes of an update are dispatched as ONE batch wave (v2v1_warm_u<UUU>_practice ident) through the SAME original_wave path (reserve/admission/episode/failure replacement over the whole batch), each with a frozen per-episode slot id (p<NN>) so repeated snapshot worlds keep distinct one-use job ids. Test: test_one_failed_practice_episode_in_the_batch_wave_is_replaced_not_escalated runs the REAL run_train_jobs.

defects.was: R planned the requested fraction count and fell back as soon as cooperative examples < count
defects.now: R's plan count is B's REALISED practice count of the same update (B_UPDATE receipt practice block; realised_count refuses when unbound), and R's cooperative pool counts examples x repeat-cap BEFORE falling back to non-cooperative examples (registry records cooperative_capacity); B never falls back.

defects.was: load_snapshot raised ValueError for seed_index >= 3 (extra_seeds examples)
defects.now: seed_index >= 3 restarts from replicate(snapshot, 'salt#sN') - the same deterministic per-seed CRN derivation, an independent generator per extra seed; unknown seed_index (< 1) still refuses. Test asserts seed-3/seed-4 independence and reproducibility.

defects.was: accel_plant.py ~92 crashed with TypeError on replayed plan_start ticks whose event['proposal'] is None (practice/replay episodes never propose a new plan)
defects.now: the guided_starts backpressure write is guarded on event.get('proposal') is not None - a replayed plan_start tick records no queue record, real executed proposals still write exactly as before. Test drives the real VerifyController replay path with a plan_start t0 sample.

what_it_does.summary: DEFAULT OFF. For B-v2v and R-v2v a registered fraction (practice_fraction, proposal 0.25 => 6 of the 24 PPO episodes of one update) of each update's PPO episodes start from snapshots of the arm's OWN admitted within-seed cooperative bank examples instead of fresh t=300 starts. A-v2v is unchanged (A keeps its 24 normal episodes; it only supplies the matched safety references).
what_it_does.snapshot_and_seed: The episode is a restart of the example's decision snapshot through the REGISTERED sumo_verify.VerifyController ('policy continues' branch semantics): exact prefix replay with the sealed prefix fingerprint check, the snapshot's own t0 command, CRN generator restore at t0 (seed-1 examples: the stored snapshot generator state; seed-2 examples: replay_bank.replicate(snapshot, verification_id); extra-seed examples seed_index>=3: replicate(snapshot, 'salt#sN')), committed snapshot plans continue, no new plan is ever proposed.
what_it_does.policy_from_t0: CAVs are controlled by the CURRENT training policy from t0 (the job carries the same weights the update's normal episodes carry; v2v/intent observation wrappers apply exactly as in every other v2v controller). PPO/viability/routing see only the strictly post-t0 seconds (practice_starts.strip_steps): the replayed prefix seconds (<= t0, including the snapshot's t0 command) carry recorded behaviour-policy data and never become training steps.
what_it_does.horizon_reward_charge: Normal 1200 s horizon stop and normal per-second team-J reward; every practice episode is charged sim_s=1200 in the SAME phase (v2v_train) through the SAME hooks as normal episodes (reserve -> admission -> episode -> failure replacement over the ONE batch wave). A failed practice episode is replaced by a normal fresh start in the same cell (accel_runner.replacement_job strips the snapshot state) and the batch failure accounting (>20%/3-consecutive escalation) applies to the WHOLE batch.
what_it_does.matched_a_safety_reference: For EACH practice episode, v2v_live.safety also runs ONE matched A-policy reference episode: the SAME snapshot and CRN seed (same branch prefix replay and t0 generator restore), A's update-u policy from t0, no guide, frozen 'pa' slot ids, charged 1200 sim-s to the arm's practice cost (v2v_train) through the same wave hooks as one batch wave. The exact pairs feed the composite safety comparison (collisions/teleports hard constraints, critical_total CI) and the paired hard-brake bootstrap; practice episodes are additionally subject to live_safety per tick exactly like every guided episode. Missing reference fails closed.
what_it_does.sampling: Uniform over the eligible examples with a per-example repeat cap per update (practice_repeat_cap, registered values 1 or 2); deterministic RNG digest(practice=plan|arm|update|training_seed|fraction|cap). The sampled plan is sealed once (replay_bank/<ARM>/PRACTICE_PLAN_<ARM>_<UUU>.json, practice_plan_sha256) and FROZEN: process restarts reuse the same rows/job ids and never re-sample even if the bank grows.
what_it_does.r_fallback: Documented: R's plan count is B's REALISED practice count of the same update (never the requested count); R's cooperative pool first counts examples x repeat-cap (registry cooperative_capacity) and only a count beyond that capacity is filled from R's OTHER ADMITTED examples (rows flagged fallback=true); B never falls back.
what_it_does.empty_bank: Empty or unresolvable bank (BankDataMissing) -> plan with zero rows -> a full normal 24-episode wave. Bank examples are the arm's own-bank decisions only (own replay_bank links; imported u3 labels are never practice starts).
what_it_does.receipts_and_report: Each practice episode RESULT.json carries a practice block (practice=true, a_reference=false, verification_id, example_id, seed_index, t0, slot, snapshot_sha256, CRN provenance, fallback, charged_sim_s; never the snapshot itself); each matched A reference carries the same block with a_reference=true. The per-update receipt <ARM>_UPDATE_<UUU>.json gains a 'practice' block ONLY when the option is ON: practice vs normal episode counts (the REALISED practice count is what R matches), distinct examples used with repeat counts, mean returns vs normal (per episode and per control second), per-episode rows.
what_it_does.per_update_sim_s_rule: Per B/R update: 24 arm episodes at 1200 sim-s (6 practice replace 6 normal episodes, delta 0) PLUS one matched A reference per practice episode at 1200 sim-s each => +practice_count*1200 = +7200 sim-s per B/R update (A unchanged). Full-run upper bound quoted: reference quote = 2 arms x 24 updates x 6 x 1200 = 345600 sim-s; prepare_intent(ON) raises the runtime's shared v2v_train allocation to V2V_PHASES['v2v_train']+345600 and each B/R dispatch's launch3 quote adds practice_count*1200 per remaining update.

practice_starts.arms: B and R equal; A unchanged

practice_fraction.meaning: fraction of the update's 24 PPO episodes that start from snapshots (0.25 => 6, and 6 matched A references per update)

practice_repeat_cap.meaning: max times one example may be used per update (the cooperative pool counts examples x cap before R falls back)

keys.equality_rule: One key set serves B and R (optional cfg['practice_starts_by_arm'] accepted only when B == R == the values); bind_runtime refuses mismatch and unregistered values

wiring.v2v_launch3: BANK_OPTIONS carries the registered launch defaults (practice_starts=False, 0.25, cap 2); PRACTICE_KEYS/PRACTICE_FRACTIONS/PRACTICE_REPEAT_CAPS; practice_reference_quote(fraction) is the registered full-run upper bound of the matched A references; practice_options_for(cfg, arm) validates B == R, OFF or registered ON, refuses A; bind_runtime validates (never pins) the practice keys so a later runtime may enable at an update boundary
wiring.prepare_intent: v2v_runner.prepare_intent(practice_starts=False, practice_fraction=None, practice_repeat_cap=None) - defaults produce the OFF launch config; ON differs from OFF in practice_starts plus the v2v_train allocation raised by the quoted A-reference upper bound; producer refuses unregistered values
wiring.v2v_live: hooks() validates practice_options_for for B and R at hook time; safety() schedules the matched A references (practice_references: one batch wave, exact pairs, fail-closed) and passes them to health.braking; launch3_check quotes the per-dispatch A-reference cost when practice ON
wiring.v2v_runner: run_arm's train wave wrapper: when enabled, plan_for_update (frozen; R counts B's REALISED practice episodes) -> original_wave for the remaining worlds -> ONE original_wave batch wave for all practice episodes (practice_batch extras, frozen p<NN> slot ids) -> results merged and pre-t0 steps stripped
wiring.warm_runner: run_arm writes the per-update 'practice' report into <ARM>_UPDATE_<UUU>.json only when b['practice_starts'] is set and the arm has a bank (the REALISED count R matches)
wiring.accel_runner: wave_jobs() is wave()'s job construction (real path): explicit keywords exactly once, extras duplicates raise TypeError, practice jobs source runtime/checkpoint/noise_seed/warm_history/accel_bounds from the recorded snapshot sumo config and key on the frozen slot id; replacement_job(): a failed practice job is replaced by a normal fresh start (practice/branch/samples keys stripped)
wiring.accel_plant: episode(): jobs with a 'practice' key restart through the registered VerifyController (+ the v2v observation wrapper for v2v jobs) and flag the receipt; guided_starts backpressure write is guarded against replayed plan_start ticks with proposal None; jobs without the key are untouched
wiring.warm_health/composite_health: braking() gained an optional exact-pairs map (episode id -> matched reference); default None keeps the legacy same-world pairing byte-identical - the rule is never weakened

how_to_enable_at_an_update_boundary: 1. Let the running V2V arms finish update k and pause at the boundary (WARM_<ARM>_PAUSED.json / resume_update=k as for any resume).

2. Produce the new runtime config: v2v_runner.prepare_intent(base, root=..., legacy_root=..., source_root=..., common_checkpoint_sha256=..., practice_starts=True) - practice_fraction/practice_repeat_cap default to the registered 0.25/2; B and R keys are identical by construction; the runtime's v2v_train allocation covers the quoted matched A-reference upper bound (V2V_PHASES v2v_train + 345600 sim-s).

3. Re-register the launch identity for the new V2V_RUNTIME.json: the launch3 gate/binding flow (gate PASS for the exact deployed commit, runtime_sha256 in a new additive LAUNCH3 binding, check_hold) exactly as at first launch; v2v_launch3.bind_runtime validates the ON values (B == R, registered fraction/cap) instead of pinning them.

4. Re-run the launch3 preflight and re-dispatch the train children with resume_update=k (v2v_live.spawn('train', arm)); the launch3 quote for each B/R child adds the matched A-reference cost (practice_count*1200 per remaining update). The first update each B/R child trains is update k+1; its practice plan freezes at that boundary (replay_bank/<ARM>/PRACTICE_PLAN_<ARM>_<k+1:03>.json).

5. Verify per update in <ARM>_UPDATE_<UUU>.json['practice'] (practice/normal counts, examples, returns vs normal) and the per-episode receipt flags in jobs/<id>/RESULT.json['practice']; the matched A references appear as jobs/<...>_pa<NN>_A_<seed>/RESULT.json with a_reference=true and feed <ARM>_SAFETY_COMPOSITE_<UUU>.json. Turning it OFF again repeats the same steps with practice_starts=False; plans already frozen stay on disk as history.

Charge note: per B/R update the practice episodes replace 6 normal episodes (delta 0) and the matched A references add practice_count*1200 = 7200 sim-s (quoted above; upper bound over the full run 345600 sim-s).

hard_rules_compliance.safety_checks_note: fix round ADDS safety coverage: practice episodes now get the composite comparison (collisions/teleports hard constraints + critical_total CI) and the paired hard-brake bootstrap via matched same-snapshot/same-CRN A references, on top of the unchanged live_safety per-tick guard; the only new early-exit is the accel_plant guard that stops writing a backpressure record for a replayed tick that has no proposal (a record that never existed), never a safety verdict
